sources.support: Treasury-repo headline revisions occur only on the original publication day, around 14:30 Eastern and above a one-basis-point threshold. Later updated statistics are a separate lagged release. The publication calendar follows SIFMA government-securities full closures, not simply federal bank holidays. Ordinary API headline percentRate is the permitted field; percentile/volume and updated-statistics products were not used.

Announced on 2024-10-23: SOFR method changes begin with 2024-11-25 publication for 2024-11-22 transactions. Earlier ordinary SOFR values will not be retroactively adjusted. TGCR/BGCR are unaffected. Preserve this real-time method boundary; do not backfill a homogeneous series.
The reconstructed indicative series is explicitly unofficial and is separate from the published headline. It was not acquired.
The 2025-01-09 mourning date was an early close, with no planned repo-rate publication change. A generic federal-holiday assumption is therefore insufficient.
The exchange describes SOFR publication for a government-securities business day on the following business day, around 08:00 Eastern, and confirms the same-day revision boundary.

delay_inference.frozen_rule: No earlier than broker calendar midnight effectiveDate + 8 calendar days; maximum age 30 calendar days.
delay_inference.support: All paired source-date gaps inside the acquired window are at most four calendar days. Combined with the next-government-securities-business-day publication policy and same-day finalization, the eight-day floor supplies a multi-day cushion for this source screen. It does not depend on sub-hour broker session matching.
delay_inference.limitation: Effective-date arrays do not contain per-release timestamps. This is a transparent schedule-based inference, not a reconstructed intraday vintage feed. Any documented exceptional late publication must be honored; no time lag may be shortened after results. The final 2025-12-31 rate is not eligible inside development.

Those out-of-window examples entered conversation context but were not extracted into source tables, models or calculations. The earlier no-2026 wording must be understood as no source acquisition/calculation, not a claim that no public example was seen.
